faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about ComputeFlux — the decentralized TEE compute network and anonymous AI gateway.
faq.what_is_tee_a: TEE (Trusted Execution Environment) is a hardware-level security enclave that isolates your code and data. On ComputeFlux, all API requests, model inferences, and token forwarding run inside TEE, meaning even the platform operator cannot see your data. This provides stronger privacy guarantees than traditional encrypted proxies.
faq.how_private: How does ComputeFlux protect my privacy?
faq.how_private_a: Every request is encrypted end-to-end and processed inside TEE secure enclaves. Your API keys, prompts, and request logs are never stored or visible to anyone — including ComputeFlux. Combined with blockchain-based settlement, you get full transparency on payments with zero data exposure.
faq.no_kyc: Do I need KYC to use ComputeFlux?
faq.no_kyc_a: No. ComputeFlux is 100% Web3 native. Simply connect your wallet (MetaMask, Polkadot.js, WalletConnect, etc.) and start using the service immediately. No email, no ID verification, no credit card.
faq.how_to_start: How do I get started as a developer?
faq.how_to_start_a: Connect your Web3 wallet, create an API key in the dashboard, and use our unified endpoint to access models across 10+ blockchains. Check our docs for quickstart guides with OpenAI-compatible SDKs, LangChain, LlamaIndex, and more.
faq.how_miners_earn: How do miners earn on ComputeFlux?
faq.how_miners_earn_a: Deploy a node using Docker on any device with idle compute (GPU, NAS, router, or bandwidth). Your node serves API requests and earns real crypto tokens — not points. Withdraw instantly to your preferred low-gas chain like Solana, Base, or Polygon.
faq.multi_chain_a: ComputeFlux supports 10+ blockchains including Ethereum, Solana, Base, Optimism, Arbitrum, Polygon, Sui, Aptos, Polkadot, and more. Both API routing and payment settlement work across all supported chains.
faq.vs_infura: How is ComputeFlux different from OpenRouter, Infura, or Alchemy?
faq.vs_infura_a: Unlike OpenRouter, Infura, and Alchemy which are centralized and may require KYC, ComputeFlux is fully decentralized with TEE privacy protection. Your requests are invisible to the platform, you pay with crypto (no credit card), and you get multi-chain access through a single API. It's the privacy-first alternative for Web3 developers.
faq.api_key_safe: Is my API key safe on ComputeFlux?
faq.api_key_safe_a: Yes. Your API key is stored inside the TEE secure enclave and is never exposed to the platform or any third party. Even if a node is compromised, the TEE hardware protection ensures your credentials remain encrypted and inaccessible.
